faq.switchPlansAnswer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your billing settings. Changes take effect immediately and are prorated.
faq.afterTrial: What happens after my trial ends?
faq.afterTrialAnswer: Your store stays active but you will be prompted to select a plan. You will never lose your data — we give you a 7-day grace period.
faq.arabicRTL: Do you support Arabic and RTL?
faq.arabicRTLAnswer: Yes. StoreOS supports both English and Arabic with full RTL layout. You can switch languages instantly from any settings page.
faq.annualDiscount: Is there a discount for annual billing?
faq.annualDiscountAnswer: Yes — switching to annual saves you 20% across all plans. The discount is applied immediately.
